content.short: Collectible 3D creatures. HODL, design and trade these eggs and creatures with our Blizzeffect Discord community.
content.description:
Ada Creatures is going to be a big collection of 3D creatures and mutations. Now pretty known for the actual eggs, sharks, dragons, dogs and more creatures minted.

Some of them planned to have breeding functions and some of them made for battles. 3D models minted are also part of the collection and always giving a super nice look to each 3D collectible is the goal for its creator (Blizzeffect).
